description: Save the session's loaded book to the filesystem. Formats: diya-gl-dir (book.toml + lines.jsonl into a directory; the default for a path with no extension), diya-gl-zip, json, xlsx (the product's recalculating workbook) and zip (the product's package). xlsx and zip fetch the template from spreadsheets.diyaccounting.co.uk on first use. With cloud: true, writes to the DIYA cloud by bookId instead (a practice client's book set with clientId), signed in as the session's credentials; carries the if-match etag from the session's last cloud open or save of the same bookId.

bookId.description: The cloud book's id; required with cloud: true

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to save into that client's book set

cloud.description: Save to the DIYA cloud by bookId instead of the filesystem

format.description: One of diya-gl-dir, diya-gl-zip, json, xlsx, zip; unused with cloud

path.description: Where to write: a directory for diya-gl-dir, otherwise a file path; unused with cloud

name: save_book
title: Save the book
